decision: Accept linguistic fidelity of both complete dated Agriculture and Bioeconomy translations
source_to_contract_mapping: Translate the later September 10 plain-language reader; preserve the original canonical-contract digest and source list as historical provenance.
checks: Compared the complete English overview and all six sections with both complete translations.
Retained separate subjects: crop variety, feedstock, processing plant and final product.
Preserved funding versus commercial availability and assessment rules versus a particular variety being distributed, planted or adopted.
Preserved the research-assessment-multiplication-distribution-use sequence and the definition of multiplication.
Preserved the one-season causal limit, changing weather and prices, revised statistics, and participants who discontinued use.
Preserved input/output/loss/destination measures, eligible-versus-actual participant denominators, distributional limits and all evidence dates.
Preserved the five original source IDs and URLs; links do not claim current retrieval.

findings.rationale: Rendement retains crop yield, production utilisable retains usable output, and multiplication explicitly means seeds or planting material. Financements avoids implying that a research award is a prize or commercial outcome.

Mejoramiento vegetal, insumos, financiamiento and manejo fit the selected regional convention. Rendimiento and producción utilizable stay separate; neither a larger harvest nor processing investment is made a universal household benefit.

integration_state: Complete local reader texts accepted for integration with separate original-contract provenance and any later exact-source context.
boundary: AI linguistic-fidelity review of dated English content only. No independent human review, fresh fact-check, accessibility certification, measurement admission or publication authorization.
